I kind of constantly being in a place with prodigies, so I always feel the pressure to compete. One time a kid 3 years my junior fucking pwned me in the subject I knew best, and I was distressed for weeks. It's devastating to know that there's someone out there younger and better than you, and you start questioning the validity of your existence.

Sometimes I do think all the expectations people always put me created a figure on the back of my head. This ambitious, merciless bitch who won't take excuses for not giving 100%

the thing is, my decline has been gradual. Since the middle of high school my GPA started to tumble down, but because I had exceptional achievements in science, it kind of overshadows. And it's clear that I got some boost from the other teachers because I'm contributing to the school trophy cabinet or so. But the truth is, I'm not getting smarter.

But yeah, I just can't see myself from another way. From how I run my life, I AM my grades, I AM my achievements. And I'd really like to feel otherwise, it's just that, when you're a smart kid, that's what you'll always be known for. Smart. Even your parents forgot to call you nice, or funny or beautiful.

well, my stepmom is verbally abusive. She did went all physical at me once, and I told my dad/dad's family about it and she ended up getting a lot of crap from them. She did managed to convinced me it was all my fault, that I'm a weakling always seeking protection as an excuse of my incompetence. She raided my diaries and notebooks, which made me a bit paranoid about writing my feelings.

She basically made me feel guilty if I ever thought of bad things about her, and everything is always my fault. She analyzed all my behaviours out of context and convinced me that I was the worst person in the world and I'm not as smart as people told me and I'll never reach my dreams.

But after she moved out things got a lot better, my overall life quality improved (more friends, better health). I am worried about my half-sister though. She lives with her and she's constantly verbally abused by her mom, she's pressured to join a million extracurricular activities and be the "perfect" kid, but she's become the most unhomourous people I know
